context: Five independent sub-moves, each a landable PR. For (2), core gains a publish_admission(result, label) -> allow/refuse+reason function; CLI translates refusals to messages/exit codes. For (4), delete run_official's monkeypatch after the service accepts streams; keep its TPC scale/stream validation rules but move them to core beside the service. Characterize before each move.
description: Relocate CLI-layer business logic per the review. (1) benchbox/cli/commands/metrics.py:120-217: Power@Size/Throughput@Size derivation and the QphH sqrt(power x throughput) computation move into core/results/metrics.py TPCMetricsCalculator; the CLI keeps parsing/emission only. (2) publish gate (benchbox/cli/commands/publish.py:96-121: compliance_class refusal + result_non_clean_reason policy) and submit compliance/clean-pass policy (submit.py:641-663) move into core/publishing / validation so any future MCP publish tool inherits identical policy. (3) tuning profile->settings mappings (tuning_group.py:207-249 _create_profile_config: optimized/streaming/memory-constrained/gpu) and the hardcoded DataFrame capability table (:562-573) move into core/tuning beside PLATFORM_TUNING_CAPABILITIES. (4) run_official's class-level monkeypatch of BenchmarkOrchestrator.execute_benchmark (run_official.py:19-63 _forward_requested_streams) is removed by making stream count a first-class run-service parameter. (5) datagen's dummy --platform duckdb injection and argv round-trip re-parse (datagen.py:79-139) are replaced by a direct run-service data_only call. (6) aggregate.py CSV assembly stays CLI but consumes core statistics (already done by one-engine-unify-statistics).

anti_patterns.dont: keep the run_official monkeypatch alongside the new streams parameter as belt-and-braces
anti_patterns.instead: delete it in the same PR that adds the parameter
anti_patterns.why: a class-level monkeypatch on the orchestrator is fragile and will silently misfire when the orchestrator thins out

anti_patterns.dont: move CLI display/formatting into core while relocating policy
anti_patterns.instead: core returns structured decisions; CLI renders them
anti_patterns.why: presentation is interaction-scoped under the contract

preserves.behavior: CLI flags, exit codes, and user-facing messages unchanged for metrics/publish/submit/run-official/datagen.
Tuning YAML files produced by tuning init remain byte-compatible for the same inputs.
publish refusal semantics identical: same inputs refuse with the same reasons.
run-official's validation rules (TPC scale allowlist, streams >= 2 floor rationale) keep their behavior, relocated.

prior_art.concept: Core publishing seam that should own admission policy
Streams parameter home replacing the monkeypatch
PLATFORM_TUNING_CAPABILITIES already core; profiles join it

verifications.expected: CLI metrics command no longer computes the composite metric.
run-official passes streams through the run service.

verifications.expected: Core admission function enforces the same refusals the CLI enforced.
